# Subwikha's Hub

> Subwikha's Hub is a handmade gift business based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India,
> founded in 2024. It makes and sells handcrafted gifts to order — chocolate bouquets,
> resin art (keychains, coasters, photo pieces), personalized photo frames, pipe cleaner
> flower bouquets, fridge magnets, and colour-changing night lights — and ships across
> India. Payments are handled by Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets); Cash on
> Delivery is not offered.

## Key Pages

- [Shop](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/shop): Full catalog of handcrafted gifts, filterable by category, occasion, and price.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/faq): Direct answers on shipping times, payment methods, returns, cancellations, customization, and order tracking.
- [Our Story](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/about): The founding story of Subwikha's Hub.
- [Contact](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/contact): How to reach Subwikha's Hub — Instagram DM or the contact form, reply within 24 hours (Mon–Sat, 10am–7pm IST).
- [Track Order](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/track-order): Look up an order's delivery status using the Order ID and checkout phone number.
- [Build a Hamper](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/hamper): Combine 2–4 handcrafted gifts into one bundle for an automatic 10% discount.
- [Gift Finder](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/gift-finder): A short quiz that recommends a gift by occasion and budget.

## Policies

- [Shipping Info](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/shipping): Processing takes 2–7 business days depending on the product (longer for custom photo items); free shipping above ₹500, ₹80 below.
- [Returns & Exchange](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/returns): Customized items are not returnable or exchangeable; damaged/incorrect items are replaced or refunded if reported within 48 hours of delivery.
- [Privacy Policy](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/privacy): What customer data is collected and how it's used; payments are processed by Razorpay (PCI-DSS compliant), no card data stored.
- [Terms of Service](https://subwikhahub.vercel.app/terms): Order, payment, and custom-order terms.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹). The business ships within India only.
- Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available — payment is required in full at checkout.
- Every product is handmade to order; minor variation between photos and the finished piece is expected, not a defect.
- For current prices, stock, and exact delivery estimates for a specific product, refer to that product's own page under /shop — this file is a static summary and does not reflect real-time catalog or pricing data.
